annotations.title: Read a North Carolina (NC) Administrative Code rule

description:
Read a North Carolina Administrative Code (NCAC) rule — a state agency regulation.

Returns the rule's text, heading, status (current, temporary, emergency, repealed,
expired, transferred or reserved), its history (adopted, amended, …, by date), the G.S.
sections it cites as AUTHORITY, and links to the rule on OAH. Give a chapter instead
("26 NCAC 03") to list that chapter's rules.

Use for agency rules; use get_statute for the General Statutes the legislature passes.
To find which rules implement a statute, use cross_references on the statute.

citation.description: An NCAC rule citation, or a chapter to list its rules. Loose forms are fine: "26 NCAC 3 .101", "10a ncac 27g .0104", "26 NCAC 03". The State Bar's rules are "27 NCAC 02 Rule 1.1" or "RPC 1.1"; the Utilities Commission's are "R8-49".
